title: 第26章 东北抗联的故事
content_zh:
回到学校，刘济民遇到了在男宿舍附近散步的朱霖。朱霖这次没有穿裙子，而是穿着灰色的长裤，手中拿着书本。

    “朱霖同学，你在这儿背书呢？”刘济民笑着问道。

    朱霖看到刘济民后，环视四周：“好...好巧啊，刘济民同学，没想到在这儿能见到你。”

    “前面就是男生宿舍。”

    “我在这儿背书呢，你呢，你是刚回来？”

    “我去了燕影厂一趟，写了个剧本，也不知道行不行！”刘济民看了一眼朱霖手中的书本，“你书是不是拿倒了？”

    “倒....倒了？”朱霖连忙看了一下，“没有啊！”

    “逗你呢，你怎么还这么老实？”

    朱霖咬着牙跺脚道：“你这人，怎么这么讨厌？再说了，‘老实’不是好词吗？”

    “没说‘老实’不是好词啊？你觉得‘老实’不是好词？”

    “你这人，我走了！”朱霖转身就要走，气得脸肥嘟嘟的，跟婴儿肥似的。

    刘济民快步跟上，笑嘻嘻地说道：“好好好，我错了，我错了！”

    “嘁！”朱霖没停下脚步，“马上快要考试了，你可得努力，我听说你专业课成绩不是很....很突出。”

    朱霖想了半天，换了一个词汇委婉地说道。

    刘济民头疼地说道：“我会努力的。”

    两人站在楼下聊了约十五分钟就分开了，朱霖走到角落里，转身目送刘济民上了楼。

    宿舍楼里，不少人都在背书，简直将宿舍办成了图书馆。

    刘济民看大家都在卖力学习，也投入到了医学的学习之中。

    刘济民跟朱霖见面的次数越来越多，虽然每次聊的时间不长，但抵不住次数多。
content_en:
Back at school, Liu Jimin met Zhu Lin who was walking near the men's dormitory. Zhu Lin did not wear a skirt this time, but wore gray trousers and held a book in his hand.

    "Classmate Zhu Lin, are you here to endorse?" Liu Jimin asked with a smile.

    After Zhu Lin saw Liu Jimin, he looked around: "What a coincidence, classmate Liu Jimin, I didn't expect to see you here."

    "The boys' dormitory is in front."

    "I'm here to endorse. What about you? Did you just come back?"

    "I went to Yan Film Studio and wrote a script, but I don't know if it will work!" Liu Jimin glanced at the book in Zhu Lin's hand, "Did you knock down the book?"

    "It's... it's fallen?" Zhu Lin quickly looked at it and said, "No!"

    "I'm kidding you, why are you still so honest?"

    Zhu Lin gritted his teeth and stamped his feet: "Why are you so annoying? Besides, isn't 'honest' a good word?"

    "I didn't say 'honest' is not a good word? Do you think 'honest' is not a good word?"

    "You man, I'm leaving!" Zhu Lin turned around and was about to leave, his face plump with anger, like baby fat.

    Liu Jimin quickly followed and said with a smile: "Okay, okay, I was wrong, I was wrong!"

    "Hey!" Zhu Lin didn't stop, "The exam is coming soon. You have to work hard. I heard that your grades in professional courses are not very... very outstanding."

    Zhu Lin thought for a long time, then changed a word and said tactfully.

    Liu Jimin said with a headache: "I will work hard."

    The two stood downstairs chatting for about fifteen minutes and then separated. Zhu Lin walked to the corner, turned around and watched Liu Jimin go upstairs.

    In the dormitory building, many people were endorsing the book, turning the dormitory into a library.

    Liu Jimin saw that everyone was studying hard and devoted themselves to the study of medicine.

    Liu Jimin and Zhu Lin met more and more often. Although they didn't chat for long each time, they couldn't resist the number of times.
